champion.tips: BLITZCRANK TIPS AND TRICKS Holding off from using your Q until the enemy has used a dash or their movement ability will make landing your Q easier. In team fights, don’t Hook Q the enemy tank if possible. Try and Hook Q a squishy champion or carry instead. Especially don’t Hook Q somebody who can engage or who has CC like Amumu. Know your matchups. When laning against someone who can engage like Alistar, Leona or Nautilus, never try to Hook Q them. Hooking Q them will make it easier for them to get onto your ADC. Try and Hook Q the ADC if instead.
champion.builds: THE BEST BLITZCRANK BUILDS, RUNES AND ITEMS FOR SUPPORT IN EMERALD + Most Popular If you want to use the most popular Blitzcrank Support build, you should take Flash and Ignite as your Summoner Spells. For runes, you should pick Glacial Augment as your keystone, followed by Hextech Flashtraption, Biscuit Delivery and Cosmic Insight in the primary tree, as well as Celerity and Nimbus Cloak in the secondary tree. For rune shards, you want Ability Haste in offense, Health Scaling in flex and Health Scaling in defense, though it depends on the matchup. Finally, for your items, you should build Celestial Opposition as your first item, followed by Boots of Swiftness and Locket of the Iron Solari. For your last 3 items, you should build Redemption, Zeke's Convergence and finish with Vigilant Wardstone. For the skill order, you want to stick with Q - E - W. Right now, this build has 49.3% winrate over 13 172 matches played. Alternative If you're looking for alternatives, you can use Flash and Ignite as your Summoner Spells, with runes being Aftershock as your keystone, Demolish, Conditioning and Overgrowth in the primary tree, and Biscuit Delivery with Cosmic Insight in the secondary tree, as well as Ability Haste, Health Scaling, and Health Scaling as your rune shards. The items that this build incorporates are Celestial Opposition as your first item, then Boots of Swiftness as a second item and Locket of the Iron Solari as a third item. You want to finish the build with Redemption, Zeke's Convergence and Vigilant Wardstone. As far as ability max order goes, you want to keep it Q - E - W. This build is currently sitting at a 49.2% win rate across 4 531 matches played. Off-Meta If you want to try an Off-Meta Blitzcrank Support build in the current patch, try Flash and Ignite as your Summoner Spells, Unsealed Spellbook, Hextech Flashtraption, Biscuit Delivery and Cosmic Insight as your primary rune tree, and Celerity with Nimbus Cloak as your secondary tree. Use Ability Haste, Health Scaling and Health Scaling as your shards. For items in this build, you want to complete Celestial Opposition as your first item, then finish Boots of Swiftness as your second item, and Redemption as third item. The last 3 options are Locket of the Iron Solari, Zeke's Convergence and Vigilant Wardstone. The ability order for this build is Q - E - W. As of the current patch, this build has a 53.4% win rate over 3 143 matches played. Situational Blitzcrank Runes and Items Depending on the context of your game, your matchup, and enemy champions, you might want to consider building some situational items or take specific runes. Carefully examine your team, enemy team, game state , and your matchup to plan your Blitzcrank build accordingly! For example, when it comes to rune shards, you might want to take either Armor or Magic Resist, depending on which champion you are about to lane against. Furthermore, if you want a more detailed breakdown, you should also check out Blitzcrank runes page.
